Frequently asked questions

What is the best free digital legacy tool?

Start with the free built-in settings: Apple Legacy Contact, Google Inactive Account Manager. For passwords, Bitwarden has a free plan; check whether emergency access needs a paid plan.

Are free plans enough?

For platform settings, yes. For password managers and vaults, emergency access may need a paid plan. Each tool page shows the plan required.
